purpose: Explicit independent-review bridge between raw quantification and portable unchanged numerical analysis; not an automatic raw-read verifier.

sources_sha256.baseline_manifest: SHA256 of locally reconstructed baseline manifest
sources_sha256.subject_map: SHA256 of locally reconstructed minimal subject map

required_top_level.runs: Exactly28 distinct fixed run_accession records; each contains files_sha256 with relative native-output and run-receipt filenames.

preprocessing.raw_pairs: ENA original pair count, positive integer
preprocessing.retained_pairs: Cutadapt output pairs; equals Salmon processed count

independent_review_must_check: Complete original compressed bytes/MD5/SHA receipts, cleaned input checksums and exact Cutadapt recipe/config for everyrun.
Full native output completeness/fingerprints, successful EM convergence, count linkage and unchanged estimator/reference settings.
Expected ISR or documented weak-directionality IU; explicit compatibility/low-mapping/coding-depth quality limits, no outcome-based exclusions.
Identical full transcript identifier sets across all28; absence from common reference distinguished from measured zero; all four pathway coverage checks.
Reconstructed clinical source consistency, all28 subjects once, no endpoint missingness, primary5vs23 and secondary2vs26.
scope_limit: This receipt attests upstream verification; publicly distributed source methods/aggregate hashes do not recreate absent raw files or clinical rows.
final_orientation_summary_source: Use detected_library_type in complete_cohort_admission.json/native meta_info plus per-run library_orientation_qc. The unchanged assembler ancillary library_types CSV column may be empty and must not substitute for the native detection field.
